title: Returns and refunds
text: Most unused products may be returned within 30 days of delivery with proof of purchase. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method after the returned item is inspected. Final-sale items and products marked non-returnable are excluded.

title: Damaged or defective items
text: Customers should report items that arrive damaged or defective within 7 days of delivery and provide the order number and photographs. Support may arrange a replacement, repair, or refund after review. Do not promise an outcome before the case is reviewed.

title: Extended warranty coverage
text: An extended warranty provides repair coverage for eligible product failures during the purchased coverage period. It does not automatically extend the store's return window. Accidental damage is covered only when the purchased plan explicitly includes accidental-damage protection.

title: Shipping and delivery
text: Estimated delivery dates are shown at checkout and in the order confirmation. Carrier scans can take up to 24 hours to appear. If tracking has not updated for 3 business days, contact support with the order number.

title: Order cancellation
text: An order may be cancelled while its status is processing and before it is handed to the carrier. Shipped orders cannot be cancelled; customers may request a return after delivery, subject to the returns policy.

title: Payment and account security
text: Support will never ask customers to share a full payment-card number, password, or one-time security code in chat. Verify account ownership using the authenticated customer session before showing order details or changing an order.
